mini-cooper.note: All versions FWD: Cooper C/S/JCW (3- and 5-door) and electric Cooper E/SE/JCW Electric

mini-aceman.note: All versions FWD (Aceman E, SE and JCW Aceman); no ALL4

bmw-1-series.note: FWD on 116, 118d, 120, 120d; xDrive on 123 xDrive and M135 xDrive

bmw-2-series-gran-coupe.note: FWD on 216, 218d, 220, 220d; xDrive on 223 xDrive and M235 xDrive

bmw-x1.note: sDrive (FWD) on 18i, 20i, 18d, 20d and iX1 eDrive20; xDrive on 23i, 20d, 23d, PHEV 25e/30e, M35i and iX1 xDrive30

bmw-x2.note: sDrive (FWD) on 20i, 18d, 20d and iX2 eDrive20; xDrive on xDrive20d, M35i xDrive and iX2 xDrive30

mini-countryman.note: FWD on ONE, C, D and electric E; ALL4 on S ALL4, electric SE ALL4 and JCW ALL4

bmw-3-series.note: RWD on 318i/320i/318d/320d and 330e Limousine; xDrive on 320d/330d/330i/330e xDrive, M340i/M340d xDrive and M3 (M xDrive; M3 Touring xDrive only). New G50 (revealed 30 Sep 2026): 318/320 RWD, 330/M350 xDrive

bmw-4-series-gran-coupe.note: RWD on 420i, 420d and i4 eDrive35/eDrive40; xDrive on 420d xDrive, 430i/430d xDrive, M440i xDrive, i4 xDrive40 and i4 M60 xDrive

bmw-i3.note: Only dual-motor versions so far: i3 40 xDrive and i3 50 xDrive (DE price list Nov 2026); no RWD version announced yet

bmw-x3.note: All European versions xDrive (20, 20d, 40d, 30e PHEV, M50); the RWD X3 20 sDrive is sold only outside Europe (Mexico)

bmw-ix3.note: RWD on the single-motor iX3 40 (added late 2026); xDrive on iX3 40 xDrive and iX3 50 xDrive (CH launch March 2026 with 50 xDrive)

bmw-ix4.note: Revealed 8 Oct 2026, deliveries 2027: iX4 40 RWD; iX4 50 xDrive and iX4 M60 xDrive dual motor

bmw-5-series.note: RWD on 520i, 520d, 530e and i5 eDrive40; xDrive on 520d xDrive, 530e xDrive, 540d xDrive, 550e xDrive, i5 xDrive40, i5 M60 xDrive and M5 (M xDrive)

bmw-7-series.note: Facelifted range is xDrive only: 740 xDrive, 740d xDrive, 750e xDrive, M760e xDrive, i7 50/60/M70 xDrive; the former RWD i7 eDrive50 is no longer listed (DE price list Nov 2026)

rolls-royce-ghost.note: All-wheel drive and all-wheel steering on all versions (Ghost, Extended, Black Badge)

rolls-royce-phantom.note: RWD with all-wheel steering (standard and Extended)

bmw-x5.note: G65 range all xDrive: X5 40 xDrive, 40d xDrive, 50e xDrive, M60e xDrive and electric iX5 60 xDrive

bmw-x6.note: All versions xDrive (xDrive40i, xDrive30d, xDrive40d, M60i xDrive, X6 M Competition)

bmw-x7.note: All versions xDrive (xDrive40i, xDrive40d, M60i xDrive)

bmw-xm.note: XM 50e and XM Label, both PHEV with M xDrive

bmw-ix.note: All versions dual-motor xDrive (xDrive45, xDrive60, M70 xDrive)

rolls-royce-cullinan.note: All-wheel drive and all-wheel steer on all versions incl. Black Badge

bmw-2-series-coupe.note: RWD on 218i, 220i, 230i, 220d and M2; xDrive on M240i xDrive and the new M2 M xDrive

bmw-4-series.note: RWD on 420i, 420d and M4 (manual/Competition); xDrive on 420d xDrive, 430i/430d xDrive, M440i/M440d xDrive and M4 Competition M xDrive (Coupé and Cabrio)

rolls-royce-spectre.note: Two motors, front and rear (190 kW front, 360 kW rear) on all versions incl. Black Badge and Series II

bmw-2-series-active-tourer.note: FWD on 218i, 220i, 218d, 220d; xDrive on 223i xDrive, 223d xDrive and PHEV 225e/230e xDrive

chery-tiggo-4.note: 1.5 TGDI petrol and 1.5 hybrid both FWD

omoda-omoda-5.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol, SHS-H hybrid and E5 electric all FWD

omoda-omoda-7.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol and SHS-P plug-in hybrid both FWD

jaecoo-jaecoo-5.note: Petrol and E5 electric both FWD

jaecoo-jaecoo-7.note: AWD only with the 1.6 T-GDI petrol (Luxury trim, UK); SHS-P plug-in and SHS-H hybrid are FWD

chery-tiggo-7.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol, Super Hybrid (CSH) plug-in and hybrid all FWD

omoda-omoda-9.note: SHS-P plug-in hybrid with two electric motors, AWD standard ('intelligent all-wheel drive')

jaecoo-jaecoo-8.note: SHS-P 1.5T 3DHT plug-in hybrid, AWD standard (6- and 7-seat)

chery-tiggo-8.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol and Super Hybrid (CSH) plug-in both FWD; the plug-in uses the same single-motor DHT system as the FWD Jaecoo 7 SHS

chery-tiggo-9.note: Super Hybrid (CSH) plug-in with 1.5T and three motors, AWD standard (same system as the Jaecoo 8)

lepas-l8.note: SHS-P 1.5T plug-in hybrid with front-wheel drive (spec confirmed for Indonesia; UK/EU spec page not reachable)

mitsubishi-colt.note: Petrol and full hybrid both FWD

mitsubishi-asx.note: Petrol, mild hybrid and full hybrid all FWD

mitsubishi-eclipse-cross.note: Electric model with a single front motor; the former 4WD Eclipse Cross PHEV is no longer sold

mitsubishi-grandis.note: Full hybrid and mild hybrid both FWD

mitsubishi-outlander.note: Plug-in hybrid with front and rear motors, 4WD on all versions

mitsubishi-l200.note: European versions are 4WD (part-time Easy Select on lower trims, Super Select 4WD-II on upper trims)

aston-martin-dbx.note: All versions AWD (DBX, DBX S, DBX707)

aston-martin-valhalla.note: V8 drives the rear axle, two electric motors drive the front axle; pure-EV mode is front-wheel drive

vinfast-vf-6.note: Single front motor on Eco and Plus

vinfast-vf-8.note: Eco and Plus both dual-motor AWD

ineos-grenadier.note: Permanent 4x4 with low-range transfer case on all versions (Station Wagon and Utility Wagon, petrol and diesel)

ineos-quartermaster.note: Permanent 4x4 with low-range transfer case on all versions (petrol and diesel)
